tip: Dates use a neuter ordinal plus the month in the genitive: восьмое марта (vosmoye marta = the eighth of March).
приятно (priyatno = pleasant) takes the dative for whoever feels it: кошке (koshke = to a cat), from кошка (koshka = cat).
The reflexive ending -сь turns the verb passive: строилась (stroilas = was being built), Moscow is not building anything itself.
лучше (luchshe = better) is the irregular comparative of хорошо (khorosho = good/well).
с plus the instrumental case means with something: с ушами (s ushami = with ear flaps).
Animate masculine nouns take a genitive-looking accusative object: козла (kozla = goat), not козёл (kozyol).
принято plus an infinitive states a custom with no subject: принято разуваться (prinyato razuvatsya = it's customary to take off shoes).
